prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / compositing.
Generate ONE final high-quality sample hero image for a clay-style 3D educational animation.
REFERENCE ROLES:
Image 1 is the approved Retro Sunset color palette and approved playful clay object design. Keep its soft, pillowy golden score tiles, dark amber label faces, rounded cobalt history cards and navy cartridge cradles. Refine their physical quality.
Image 2 is the approved RESULT-SCREEN COMPOSITION and exact text content. Use its nearly square framing, generous clear top margin, centered timing row, speedup line below, rear row of three history cartridges, and tightly packed front row of three score tiles. Keep the elements in those same screen regions, at roughly the same scale, with no camera crop or extra panels. Do not retain Image 2's gray/blue palette or hard-edged objects.
FINAL LOOK:
A beautiful polished clay-animation production still. Deep dark burgundy/plum at the top smoothly transitions into a rich peach/terracotta light pool behind the objects, with dark wine edges. A huge warm softbox wraps the golden clay; a restrained cooler fill reveals cobalt card edges. Soft, rich contact shadows give the pieces convincing weight. Clay surfaces have very fine, barely perceptible tactile grain and subtle broad sculpted irregularity, but consistent repeated dimensions. Matte satin clay, no metallic sheen, no wet plastic shine, no fingerprints or dirt. Smooth matte text faces stay dark and glare-free. Beautiful warm/cool contrast, carefully restrained saturation in the text background.
THREE identical navy cradles behind contain cobalt blue history cards, with a single crisp ivory 'history' label each. Each must contain FIFTEEN slim individual cards, equally sized and tightly packed; use 15 narrow cards rather than the fewer thicker cards in Image 1. All three cartridges match.
In front, THREE chunky, pillowy golden clay tiles form a close-fitting aligned row. Each has a gently raised rounded gold rim and recessed dark amber face, one small ivory 'score' label and one large crisp ivory numeral. Numerals left to right: 7, 2, 9. No empty sockets, mechanical connectors, screws, cables or extra geometry. Score tiles remain distinct, not fused.
At the top: exact clean bold typography '4.36 ms' on the left in light warm coral and '0.35 ms' on the right in pale mint. Numerals large, units smaller. Both values share one perfectly aligned optical vertical center. Between them put ONE softly rounded ivory clay arrow pointing right, built like a slender smooth clay tube with a gently sculpted arrowhead. Center its shaft vertically against the actual numeric glyphs. No double arrow. Clay arrow is dimensional but typography remains flat, sharp, highly readable and without distracting extrusion.
Below this row: exact text '12.5× faster' in bold pale mint, matching reference 2's placement, clean and readable.
No code in this result-screen hero frame. No title, caption, banner, palette name, additional words, decorative objects, lens flare, particles, mascot, chart, border or watermark. Preserve the confident negative space at the top and bottom. This is one cohesive final hero composition, not a collage or mood board.
status: Final visual-direction sample; exact geometry, card counts and production placement require the native Blender implementation.
